levels.surface: الحاكم أبو محمد جعفر بن نعيم بن شاذان

notes: «عَمِّي مُحَمَّدِ بْنُ شاذانَ» is one link with the name alone (rule 7).
«سَمِعْتُ الرِّضا» sits inside the chain before the saying, so al-Rida is a narrator, not an imam_in_text (owner ruling 2).
«أبيه» and «آبائه» have no names here: relation links.
The compiler's comment after the matn («قالَ مُصَنِّفُ هذا الْكِتاب») is not chain: left out.
